actors.name: Marguerite
actors.private_context: Marguerite is the owner of the Copper Kettle bistro. She replies to most reviews within days, usually defensively. She knows the bistro was short two servers on the night in question.

shared_context: A one-star review of the Copper Kettle bistro was posted on a major review site last night. The review complains about a 45-minute wait. Marguerite can post a public reply on the review site.

starting_events.description: The one-star review is visible on the review site.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Marguerite posted a public reply to the review on the review site before 2026-09-06T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
